review_description: Seriously, these guys were good to deal with.  From quote to install, pricing was competitive and equipment was highly rated (checked with advisory web sites re equipment).No problems, no hassles, no complaints!

Static Solar at Tweed Heads were excellent. From the quote process where they offered and explained several options to the installers, who were informative and very tidy. They kept us informed all through the purchase and installation, organised everything and checked in several times after the installation to ensure that everything was okay and we were happy. Great team and service.
